description: Validate/normalize a GrowSurf webhook payload and generate a best-effort idempotency key for dedupe.
name: growsurf_webhook_normalize

outputSchema.description: Webhook payload validation result. `ok: true` includes the normalized envelope and an idempotency key; `ok: false` includes `error`.

envelope.description: The normalized webhook envelope. Present only when `ok` is `true`.

createdAt.description: When the event occurred, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

error.description: Why the payload failed validation. Present only when `ok` is `false`.

idempotencyKey.description: A deterministic key for ignoring duplicate deliveries. Present only when `ok` is `true`.

ok.description: Whether the payload is a valid GrowSurf webhook envelope.

title: Normalize Webhook Payload
